entities.summary: Yasuyoshi Shirasawa , also known as Homi Shirasawa, was a Japanese botanist who worked alongside Tomitaro Makino 'The Father of Japanese Botany', at the University of Tokyo. Shirasawa named numerous native plants, notably the endangered Picea koyamae and the Kyūshū Lime Tilia kiusiana.
